channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Child killed, another injured in Fort Pierce bicycle crash with FedEx truck
item.description:
A child died and another was hospitalized after a bicycle collided with a FedEx truck Monday afternoon in Fort Pierce, according to the Florida Highway Patrol.

item.title: Tuition-free tech charter school to open in Fort Pierce in August
item.description: A new tuition-free career and technical charter school is preparing to open in Fort Pierce in August, bringing a hands-on approach to education to the Treasure Coast. item.title: Murray Middle School demolition begins after Hurricane Milton tornado damage
item.description: Murray Middle School demolition is underway in Martin County, marking the start of a major reconstruction effort following tornado damage caused by Hurricane Milton.

item.title: St. Lucie County residents adjust diets as E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks spread
item.description: Health officials confirmed five local cases of cyclospora since May, including two in St. Lucie County and one in Martin County, prompting residents to change what they eat and avoid.

item.title: New tuition-free tech school SouthTech Treasure Coast to open in Fort Pierce in August
item.description: SouthTech Treasure Coast will give middle and high school students the opportunity to earn industry certifications while completing their traditional coursework, helping them build real-world skills before they graduate.

item.title: Boynton Beach firefighters rescue dog from raw sewage lift station
item.description: A dog fell roughly 10 to 12 feet into a lift station holding about 2 feet of raw sewage Thursday, prompting a specialized confined space rescue.

item.title: Wellington teen injured after electric bike rider strikes him during stunt near Lion Country Safari
item.description: A Wellington teenager suffered multiple injuries, including broken bones, after being struck by an electric bike rider performing a wheelie on Tuesday night.

item.title: Wildfire burns 2,500 acres in western Palm Beach County, 30% contained
item.description: A wildfire burning in western Palm Beach County has grown to 2,500 acres and is 30% contained, according to the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: Family sues Port St. Lucie Urban Air after 6-year-old girl killed in go-kart crash
item.description: A wrongful death lawsuit was filed Monday against Urban Air Trampoline and Adventure Park after Emma Riddle died in a go-kart crash at the Port St. Lucie facility in December 2025.

item.title: Firefighters union disputes St. Lucie County Fire District terminations, calls investigation biased
item.description: Professional Firefighters and Paramedics of St. Lucie County is challenging the fire district's decision to terminate three firefighters and suspend two others for incidents that occurred in March and September 2024.

item.title: Palm Beach County man leads Martin County deputies on high-speed chase through Indiantown
item.description: A Palm Beach County man led Martin County deputies on a high-speed chase through Indiantown after driving more than 100 mph on State Road 710.

item.title: St. Lucie County Sheriff ramps up traffic enforcement with focus on speeding, reckless driving
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office is intensifying traffic enforcement this summer, deploying additional deputies and launching a new targeting initiative aimed at reducing speeding and reckless driving across the county.

item.title: 2 men killed in early morning shooting in Port St. Lucie neighborhood
item.description: Port St. Lucie Police Department is investigating a double fatal shooting that occurred early Sunday morning in a residential neighborhood. Officers responded around 3:30 a.m. to t

item.title: Family sues Port St. Lucie Urban Air after 6-year-old dies in go-kart crash
item.description: The parents of Emma Riddle filed a wrongful death lawsuit Monday against Urban Air Trampoline and Adventure Park, alleging the facility ignored safety protocols that led to their daughter's death in December 2025.

item.title: Port St. Lucie couple fights rezoning of lot behind their home, says voices went unheard
item.description: A Port St. Lucie couple is searching for answers after the city council voted to rezone the lot behind their home from residential to commercial, despite their months-long opposition.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route due to low demand, last flight September 9
item.description: JetBlue is ending its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on September 9. The airline cited low demand as the reason for ending the route, which launched in December.

item.title: E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks hit Treasure Coast, residents avoid lettuce and berries
item.description: Two confirmed cases of cyclospora infections occurred in St. Lucie County and one in Martin County since May, part of nationwide E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks linked to contamin

item.title: Fort Pierce neighbors pack planning meeting over Causeway Cove high-rise development proposal
item.description: The Causeway Cove development project was reviewed by the Fort Pierce Planning Board on Monday. The project includes five high-rise buildings, including a 17-story building standing 192 feet tall.

item.title: Hobe Sound couple seeks support as husband battles head and neck cancer
item.description: Dave and Faren Motz of Hobe Sound are asking for community support as Dave battles head and neck cancer, facing nearly $20,000 in out-of-pocket costs for treatment.

item.title: Villa Del Sol residents return home after nearly 2 years following structural damage repairs
item.description: Villa Del Sol residents in St. Lucie County told WPTV they are able to return home after nearly two years of being displaced from their condos.

item.title: Messi bathed Yamal as baby in 2007 photo shoot, now they meet in World Cup final
item.description: A 2007 charity calendar photo shoot paired teenage Lionel Messi with infant Lamine Yamal. Now 19 years later, they face off in Sunday's World Cup final.

item.title: President Trump to Attend World Cup Final in New Jersey with Stepped-Up Security
item.description: The World Cup final Sunday in New Jersey has been designated a Level 1 Special Event with President Trump attending the trophy presentation and enhanced security from multiple federal agencies.

item.title: Major League Baseball Restricts iPad Use in Dugouts to Block AI Decision-Making
item.description: MLB has made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible starting Wednesday to prevent teams from using artificial intelligence to make in-game decisions about substitutions and pitch calling.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks mile world record with 3:42.66 run in London
item.description: Josh Kerr shattered a 27-year-old world record on Saturday, running the mile in 3:42.66 at a Diamond League event in London.

item.title: Spain defeats Argentina 1-0 to win 2026 World Cup in extra time thriller
item.description: Spain defeated Argentina 1-0 on Sunday to win the 2026 FIFA World Cup championship. Ferran Torres scored the winning goal in the 106th minute of extra time, burying a left-footed s

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts earn top 15 national finish, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month and qualified for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. Sk

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis Jr. join Miami Heat in major trade
item.description: The Miami Heat introduced two-time NBA MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo and forward Bobby Portis Jr. at the Kaseya Center on Thursday, with both players receiving standing ovations from fans.

item.title: Boca Raton TLC Program Offers Summer Service Projects for South Florida Families
item.description: B'nai Torah Congregation's TLC Program connects volunteers with hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking and literacy efforts.

item.title: Palm Beach County Food Bank serves 2,500 hot meals daily to children at 35 summer sites
item.description: The Palm Beach County Food Bank in Lake Worth Beach is serving approximately 2,500 hot meals each day to nearly 1,250 children through Florida's Summer BreakSpot program while school is out.

item.title: Downtown Delray Beach launches Wellness Pass with free fitness classes and spa deals for July and August
item.description: The Delray Beach Downtown Development Authority launched the Downtown Delray Wellness Pass for July and August. The mobile-exclusive pass allows users to access complimentary classes, discounted wellness treatments and promotions from participating businesses.

item.title: Delray Beach dance studio hosts Bridgerton masquerade gala July 24 for ninth anniversary
item.description: Fred Astaire Dance Studios Delray Beach is celebrating nine years with a Bridgerton-style masquerade gala featuring themed decor and dancing.

item.title: Palm Beach Zoo extends Kids Free program through August 10
item.description: Palm Beach Zoo extended its Kids Free promotion through August 10, allowing up to four children ages 3 to 12 to receive free admission with one adult ticket.

item.title: Federal judge weighs Florida's assurances that Alligator Alcatraz detention facility won't reopen
item.description: A federal judge heard arguments Monday on whether Florida's Alligator Alcatraz detention facility has closed permanently, as state attorneys presented aerial photos showing the remote Everglades airstrip now empty of the sprawling complex that housed immigrant detainees for nearly a year. item.title: Florida's back-to-school tax holiday begins, runs through August 20
item.description: Florida families can purchase qualifying school supplies, clothing, and electronics tax-free during the month-long holiday that started Monday.

item.title: 85 percent of Florida families spend more than affordability benchmark on childcare, report finds
item.description: Childcare costs in Florida far exceed the federal affordability benchmark, with families spending a median 13.9 percent of income on care.

item.title: Byron Donalds, David Jolly hold leads as Florida governor's race enters final primary stretch
item.description: Republican U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds and Democrat David Jolly are positioned as frontrunners heading into Florida's August 18 primary, as opponents scramble for late breakthroughs.

item.title: Florida's back-to-school tax-free holiday runs through Aug. 20
item.description: Families across the Palm Beaches and Treasure Coast are taking advantage of the tax-free holiday, which exempts qualifying clothing, school supplies, and electronics from sales tax.

item.title: Security First Insurance lowers Florida homeowners rates by average of 5.6%, launches disappearing deductible program
item.description: The Ormond Beach-based insurer announced rate reductions and a new program that rewards claims-free customers by reducing their deductible 20% each year over five years.

item.title: DEA chief joins Orlando fentanyl summit as teens, grieving parents unite against deadly drug crisis
item.description: The Fentanyl Free America Summit in Orlando drew students from anti-drug coalitions nationwide, grieving parents, and DEA Administrator Terrance Cole for a coordinated response to the ongoing fentanyl threat.

item.title: More Than 70 Animals Found in Stuart Home During Large-Scale Hoarding Response
item.description: 77-year-old Gail Giustino was arrested on two misdemeanor animal cruelty-related charges following the search of a Stuart home where Martin County authorities found more than 70 an

item.title: Two Martin County brush fires contained, more expected this summer
item.description: Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike, both now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: Family files wrongful death lawsuit after 6-year-old dies in go-kart crash at Port St. Lucie Urban Air
item.description: The family of Emma Riddle filed a lawsuit Monday against Urban Air Trampoline and Adventure Park, alleging the facility ignored safety protocols that led to the child's fatal crash in December 2025.

item.title: Firefighters' union disputes St. Lucie County Fire District terminations, calls investigation biased
item.description: Professional Firefighters and Paramedics of St. Lucie County is demanding arbitration for five members terminated or suspended over incidents the fire district called hazing, but the union says did not involve hazing.

item.title: Double fatal shooting in Port St. Lucie stemmed from jealousy over woman, police say
item.description: Carl Loubeau, 24, and Juliun Stokes, 22, both from Fort Pierce, died early Sunday after an exchange of gunfire at a residence on Southeast Rivergreen Circle.

item.title: Fellsmere animal sanctuary rebuilds after fire with more than $100,000 in community support
item.description: Ted Pankiewicz founded For the Love of Paws in Fellsmere in 2014 as a nonprofit in memory of his late wife. item.title: JetBlue ending Vero Beach to New York JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. The airline cited low demand as th

item.title: Fellsmere animal sanctuary rebuilds with $100,000 in donations after fire killed 11 cats
item.description: For the Love of Paws, a Fellsmere animal sanctuary, is rebuilding with more than $100,000 in community donations after a fire on March 9 destroyed the facility and killed 11 cats.

item.title: Indian River County families can apply for free or reduced-price student meals starting July 15
item.description: Families in Indian River County are able to apply for free or reduced price meals for students starting July 15.

item.title: JetBlue ending direct flights from Vero Beach to JFK Airport in September
item.description: JetBlue is ending its direct flights between New York's JFK Airport and Vero Beach Regional Airport, citing low passenger demand for the route that launched in December.

item.title: Vero Beach parents sue city over infant son's remains allegedly disturbed and reburied without consent
item.description: Adam Chrzan and Tanya Crovo allege their infant son's remains were disturbed during maintenance at Crestlawn Cemetery and reinterred without their knowledge.
